scope: Process orchestration only; no CUDA or training.
windows_native_execution: Not available in the local Linux runtime; the same native suite runs on the laptop.

implementation.Windows: Gated launcher joins kill-on-close Job Object before starting worker; exact-PID taskkill /T /F on forced stop; job verifies no active descendants.
implementation.POSIX: Owned process group/session with TERM then KILL; /proc used only when PID namespace matches runtime.
